headline: FIFA Falls Victim to Cyberattack with Personal and Business Data Accessed
summary: FIFA stated it was the victim of a criminal cyberattack that gave unauthorized access to personal and business information, though World Cup stake sell-off files remained unaffected.
why: Global governing bodies manage sensitive internal operations and commercial data vulnerable to cyber incidents.

impacts.name: Sports administration sector
impacts.why: Cyber security breaches compromise internal operational data without immediate direct financial market impact.
